observations.why: Imperative directive issued from position authority, controlling what knowledge is retained — a command to alter the informational record.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.

observations.why: Position-authority command to erase specific knowledge from the record, exercising control over what information persists.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget… Remove all knowledge about…
mints.frame: Is the speaker here exercising authority to command what the record retains or discards, rather than persuading on the merits?
